assignments_late_window_chk.name: assignments_late_window_chk
assignments_late_window_chk.value: "assignments"."late_until" IS NULL OR ("assignments"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."late_allowed" AND "assignments"."late_until" > "assignments"."due_at")

assignments_penalty_chk.name: assignments_penalty_chk
assignments_penalty_chk.value:
("assignments"."late_penalty_type" = 'none' AND "assignments"."late_penalty_value" IS NULL)
       OR ("assignments"."late_penalty_type" = 'points' AND "assignments"."late_penalty_value" > 0)
       OR ("assignments"."late_penalty_type" = 'percent' AND "assignments"."late_penalty_value" > 0 AND "assignments"."late_penalty_value" <= 100)

terms_dates_chk.name: terms_dates_chk
terms_dates_chk.value: "terms"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "terms"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "terms"."ends_on" >= "terms"."starts_on"

users_student_no_role_chk.name: users_student_no_role_chk
users_student_no_role_chk.value:
("users"."role" = 'student' AND "users"."student_no_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."student_no_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."display_name" IS NULL)
       OR ("users"."role" <> 'student' AND "users"."student_no_hash" IS NULL AND "users"."student_no_enc" IS NULL)
